name: Ereface Miatenna Selice
original_name: 阿尔菲斯·米亚特纳·赛丽斯
source:
The Seventh Princess is as gentle and kind as the sister next door and is very considerate to everyone. She loves reading books and often stays in the library for days on end, relying only on a small amount of food and water to maintain her strength (and is often forced by Fionn to carry her back out of the library). She has the ability of instant memory and can never forget the books she has read, and she can also find the principle of the magic used by others and counteract it after reading it, but she seems to be more interested in supporting magic than attacking magic, and she has his own research on forbidden magic and interpreting magic.

Translated with DeepL from [url=https://www.baike.com/wikiid/4766777124934008990]baike[/url]
